Text: Giving an AI agent broader capabilities can require selecting and installing skills from a large ecosystem.

OpenClaw Master Skills is a curated, weekly-updated collection of skills intended to help an AI agent do more.

It can be installed through ClawHub or cloned so an individual skill directory can be copied into the OpenClaw workspace skills directory.

Key features:
• Curates skills from across the ecosystem and describes the collection as hand-picked.
• Lists 561 skills in its skill index.
• Groups skills into categories including AI & LLM Tools, Search & Web, and Productivity & Office.
• Includes browser automation skills for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
• Includes research and search skills that return grounded answers or cited reports.
